value.body: An NLP engineer builds software that works with human language, such as chatbots, search, translation and text classification. Product companies, AI startups, IT services firms and research labs hire them. A day involves preparing text data, training or fine-tuning language models, evaluating results and integrating them into products.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech / MCA; an M.Tech or MS is common in research-heavy roles

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, vector databases

items.label: AI professionals in India
items.note: All AI roles, not only NLP; Nasscom projects 12.5 lakh+ by 2027

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Fresher NLP roles are limited. Many people enter as ML or software engineers and move into language work. Projects such as fine-tuning a model, building a retrieval system or contributing to open source help show the skill.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Working with language models and embeddings

value.title: At a glance
items: The field changes quickly as large language models evolve.
Common next roles: senior NLP or ML engineer, applied scientist, AI team lead.
Research-heavy roles often expect a postgraduate degree or publications.
